template.name: Multisig Wallet: Signature Request
template.field: Action Required: Bitcoin Multisig Wallet Setup - ${object.workflow_id.wallet_name}

Bitcoin Multisig Wallet Setup Request

Dear ${object.name},

You have been designated as Cosigner #${object.cosigner_index} for a new Bitcoin multisig wallet:

Wallet Name: ${object.workflow_id.wallet_name}
Configuration: ${object.workflow_id.m_threshold}-of-${object.workflow_id.n_total} multisig
Script Type: ${object.workflow_id.script_type}
Use Case: ${dict(object.workflow_id._fields['use_case'].selection).get(object.workflow_id.use_case)}
Deadline: ${object.workflow_id.expiry_date.strftime('%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p') if object.workflow_id.expiry_date else 'No deadline set'}

Action Required:

Please provide your extended public key (xPub) and digitally sign the wallet configuration.

Complete Signature Request

Required Information:

  • Your hardware wallet's extended public key (xPub) for derivation path: ${object.workflow_id.derivation_path}
  • Hardware wallet model and firmware version
  • Master fingerprint (8 characters)
  • Last 4 digits of device serial number (for identification)
⚠️ Security Reminder:
  • Never share your seed phrase or private keys
  • Only provide your extended PUBLIC key (xPub)
  • Verify the wallet configuration matches what was agreed upon
  • Use a secure connection when accessing the signature portal

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the workflow initiator:

${object.workflow_id.initiated_by.name}
${object.workflow_id.initiated_by.email}

This is an automated message from the Bitcoin Multisig Wallet Management System.
Workflow ID: ${object.workflow_id.name}
Form Data Hash: ${object.workflow_id.form_data_hash}

template.name: Multisig Wallet: Setup Complete
template.field: ${','.join([str(sig.signer_partner_id.id) for sig in object.signature_ids if sig.signer_partner_id])}

✅ Multisig Wallet Successfully Created

Dear Cosigners,

The Bitcoin multisig wallet "${object.wallet_name}" has been successfully created with all required signatures.

Wallet Details:

Configuration: ${object.m_threshold}-of-${object.n_total} multisig
Script Type: ${object.script_type}
Created Date: ${object.completed_date.strftime('%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p')}

Next Steps:

  1. Download and securely store the BSMS file from the wallet record
  2. Import the BSMS file into your wallet software
  3. Verify the first receive address matches across all devices
  4. Perform a test transaction with a small amount
View Wallet Details
✓ Security Verification:

Form Data Hash: ${object.form_data_hash}

Please verify this matches the hash shown during your signature process.

Thank you for participating in this secure multisig wallet setup.

Best regards,
${object.initiated_by.name}

template.name: Bitcoin Balance Alert
template.field:

🚨 CRITICAL BALANCE ALERT 🚨

<% elif alert and alert.alert_type == 'low' %>

📈 HIGH BALANCE ALERT

🚀 VELOCITY LIMIT ALERT

<% else %>

📊 BALANCE MONITORING ALERT

<% endif %> <% if alert %>

${alert.message}

Time: ${alert.alert_date.strftime('%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p UTC')}

<% endif %>

Wallet Information

Wallet Name: ${object.multisig_wallet_id.name}
Monitor: ${object.name}
Current Balance: ${object.current_balance:.8f} BTC
Previous Balance: ${object.previous_balance:.8f} BTC
24h Average: ${object.avg_balance_24h:.8f} BTC
<% if object.monitor_type == 'threshold' %>

Threshold Configuration

<% if object.critical_threshold %>

● Critical Threshold: ${object.critical_threshold:.8f} BTC

<% endif %> <% if object.low_threshold %>

● Low Threshold: ${object.low_threshold:.8f} BTC

<% endif %> <% if object.high_threshold %>

● High Threshold: ${object.high_threshold:.8f} BTC

<% endif %>
<% endif %>

Recommended Actions

<% if alert and alert.alert_type == 'critical' %>
  • Immediately review wallet security
  • Consider emergency fund replenishment
  • Contact other cosigners if unexpected
  • Review recent transaction history
<% elif alert and alert.alert_type == 'low' %>
  • Plan fund replenishment if needed
  • Review upcoming expenses
  • Consider adjusting thresholds
<% elif alert and alert.alert_type == 'high' %>
  • Consider fund allocation strategies
  • Review security measures for larger balances
  • Update insurance coverage if applicable
<% elif alert and alert.alert_type == 'velocity' %>
  • Review recent spending activity
  • Verify all transactions were authorized
  • Consider if velocity limits need adjustment
  • Contact other cosigners to confirm activity
<% else %>
  • Review the alert details above
  • Check wallet activity if unexpected
  • Update monitoring settings if needed
<% endif %>
